about: The unified montage's draft disclosures for the Assos fixture, recorded on origin/main ff5f2adbe (before the route registry): route_disclosure.strategy_notices / ask_declines / card_text over the draft's strategy, live brief and pinned media (score_assos.build_job). 'assos' is the fixture as recorded; 'assos_every_field' sets every_field on the strategy and appends extra_asks to the brief. tests/kria/test_route_registry_flag_off.py requires ROUTE_REGISTRY_ENABLED=false to give exactly this.
